description: This file contains unit tests for Deep Links Security features in the OpenClawKit project, specifically testing URL validation and deep link parsing for security constraints such as loopback addresses and TLS settings.

classes.name: DeepLinksSecurityTests
classes.description: A test suite containing multiple security-related tests for deep link URL validation and handling.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkRejectsInsecureNonLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that a non-loopback WebSocket deep link with insecure TLS is rejected.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkRejectsInsecurePrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Tests that a URL with a bypassed host address outside loopback is rejected.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkAllowsLoopbackWs
methods.description: Confirms that a secure loopback WebSocket URL is accepted and correctly parsed.

methods.name: setupCodeRejectsInsecureNonLoopbackWs
methods.description: Verifies that setup codes with non-loopback WebSocket URLs and insecure TLS are rejected.

methods.name: setupCodeRejectsInsecurePrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Checks rejection of setup codes with URLs bypassing host restrictions outside loopback addresses.

methods.name: setupCodeAllowsLoopbackWs
methods.description: Ensures that setup codes with loopback WebSocket URLs are accepted.
